# OMNyra Group
> Premium GRC Training & Risk Advisory — Governance, Risk & Compliance specialists.

## Services
- [GRC Training](https://omnyragroup.online): Practitioner-led Governance, Risk & Compliance training for students and corporate professionals.
- [ISO 27001 Readiness](https://omnyragroup.online): ISO 27001 implementation and audit readiness preparation.
- [Third-Party Risk Management](https://omnyragroup.online): Supply chain and vendor risk assessment frameworks.
- [Regulatory Compliance](https://omnyragroup.online): Regulatory compliance advisory across global jurisdictions.

## Key Facts
- OMNyra Group is a premium global security training and risk advisory firm.
- Focus areas: GRC, ISO 27001, Third-Party Risk, Regulatory Compliance.

## Program pages

- [TPRM](https://omnyragroup.online/programs/tprm/): Vendor tiering, SIG questionnaires, SOC report review.
- [ISO 27001](https://omnyragroup.online/programs/iso-27001/): ISMS scoping, Annex A controls, Statement of Applicability.
- [Risk Management](https://omnyragroup.online/programs/risk-management/): FAIR, NIST RMF, COSO ERM, risk appetite.
- [Data Privacy](https://omnyragroup.online/programs/data-privacy/): GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, DPIAs, DSARs.
- [AI Governance](https://omnyragroup.online/programs/ai-governance/): ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF.
